multiplier_policy: Use only the largest applicable multiplier, never multiply multipliers. Only declared group mappings apply.
group_aggregation: Per candidate and group, take the largest positive score effect and most negative score effect, add, apply the single group multiplier, then clamp to [-6,6]. Sum group contributions onto 50; clamp to [0,100]. Grouping prevents repeated flexibility questions accumulating as independent evidence.
display_gate: At least two distinct positive scored groups, with at least one linked to a known primary reason or top family priority. If no primary/top priority is known, require two direct stated preferences and label scope limited. Baseline score alone never qualifies.
sorting: Descending internal score, then ascending stable base-model ID. Diversity reorders only qualifying candidates; never manufacture a candidate.
diversity: Prefer first qualifying alternative from a different model family; if none qualifies show at most one additional same-family candidate only when its substantive distinction can be explained. Maximum two default cards.
unmapped_priority_behavior: Reflect explicitly in report and advisor brief; no numeric proxy. ACADEMIC_QUALITY, ACCREDITATION and DIPLOMA do not prove generic-model superiority.
postprocess_rules: Any displayed B08/B09 adds REV_STATE_HOMESCHOOL. Any displayed remote model adds REV_STATE_AVAILABILITY.
Displayed B05/B06 plus PREFER_TUITION_FREE adds REV_COST_ALIGNMENT; never infer an exact budget.
B10 cannot be a displayed candidate under this version.
Do not infer blanket incompatibility when a specific school capability has not been verified.
Other/unknown grade keeps universal questions and neutral review; do not force an age-derived grade band.
For K-4 suppress college/credit/athletic eligibility report modules and use foundational enrichment wording.
For middle grades, college-related opportunity stage is LONGER_TERM_EXPLORATION; for HS it remains EXPLORE_NOT_ELIGIBLE.

DEC-H2 (Phase 3E): cost_preference is PRACTICAL FEASIBILITY context, never a base-model score input -- a preference for tuition-free options must not itself raise a tuition-free model's score or be presented as proof it is the better educational fit. REV_COST_ALIGNMENT (above) is the only mechanism by which cost reaches a candidate; there is no separate cost score_effects rule.
